cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: GREEN; 799 passed, 5 ignored, 0 failed.
cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings: GREEN.
Mutation of the composition fix (q * turn back to turn * q): RED; the pin failed on X− for the oblique setup. Restored fix: GREEN; 1 test passed. No new guards beyond this composition correction.

AGENTS checks passed. Changed source files are 276 and 242 lines. No production unwrap/expect/panic was added. No golden, snapshot PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo dependency, .github, or scripts changes. Body includes Changelog: and Fixes #1495.

Extra case: Euler conversion at gimbal lock could turn the setup incorrectly. Scratch probes using the repository quaternion functions passed 1,080 four-turn sequences and 1,080 mixed-axis 24-turn sequences at and near both ±90° pitch. These check numerical rotation behavior, not GUI clicks or machining.

Temporary mutation restored. No code changes or pushes.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b94e29016d5af0c6890856f404c98053208b69ab -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.**

**What looks good**
- The fix is one line: `quat_mul(q, turn)` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs:271`. Right composition turns about the setup axes. This is what issue #1495 asked for.
- The new test `quarter_turns_follow_each_oblique_setup_axis_in_both_directions` pins all three axes and both signs. It also checks that the origin stays.
- The change goes through the existing `SetWcs` command. Undo and redo keep their current behaviour.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1495-wcs-local-turns.md` records the choice and the dropped option.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #1495`. No snapshot PNG changed.

**Results merged with main**
These ran on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43632464783 (main at 058e14ca0, trial merge clean).
- Quick gate (ui suites): pass. `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 775 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored (the ignored ones are the snapshot lanes).
- The four mapped ui binaries (boundary, boundary_picks, sinker_setup, theme_files): 24 passed, 0 failed.
- The new pinning test ran and passed.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The diff adds no Windows-only reading, so no local re-run was owed.

**Requested before merge**
1. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. This PR changes what the user sees: the quarter turns now rotate the WCS about its own axes in the view. A screenshot pair of one oblique setup, before and after a turn, shows the fix. (Rule from issue #1209.)

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The ui label update at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs:89` matches the new behaviour.
- The Model page keeps its quarter turns about the world axes (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:1094`, `turn_model` at `pages.rs:327`). Its label still says so, so it stays true. If Model turns should follow the same rule, file a separate issue.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs` does not assert the changed label text. No structural assertion needed an update.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
